mapper.select: SELECT * FROM sys_depart_role WHERE depart_id IN ( SELECT id FROM sys_depart WHERE id IN (SELECT dep_id FROM sys_user_depart WHERE user_id=#{userId}) AND org_code LIKE CONCAT(#{orgCode},'%') )
select sr.role_name as name,sr.id as id from sys_role sr join sys_user_role sue on sr.id=sue.role_id join sys_user su on su.id=sue.user_id WHERE sue.user_id=#{id} GROUP BY role_name
